/**
 * @name Unsafe shell command execution
 * @description Using shell=True in subprocess calls can lead to command injection
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/unsafe-shell-command
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "run", "Popen", "check_call", "check_output"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("system").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("popen").getACall()
  ) and
  (
    // Check for shell=True argument
    exists(DataFlow::Node arg |
      arg = call.getArgByName("shell") and
      arg.asExpr().(BooleanLiteral).booleanValue() = true
    )
    or
    // os.system always uses shell
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("system").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe shell command execution."
findings.hypothesis: Check for subprocess calls with shell=True or os.system which can lead to command injection

message.text: Potentially unsafe shell command execution.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Hardcoded credentials
 * @description Hardcoded credentials in source code can be discovered and exploited
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/hardcoded-credentials
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-798
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from Assign assign, StrConst str
where
  (
    assign.getATarget().(Name).getId().toLowerCase().matches(["%password%", "%passwd%", "%pwd%", "%secret%", "%token%", "%api_key%", "%apikey%"]) or
    assign.getATarget().(Attribute).getName().toLowerCase().matches(["%password%", "%passwd%", "%pwd%", "%secret%", "%token%", "%api_key%", "%apikey%"])
  ) and
  assign.getValue() = str and
  str.getText().length() > 3 and
  not str.getText() = "" and
  not str.getText().toLowerCase().matches(["%password%", "%token%", "%secret%", "%key%", "%none%", "%null%", "%example%", "%test%", "%dummy%", "%placeholder%"])
select assign, "Potential hardcoded credential: " + str.getText()
findings.hypothesis: Check for hardcoded credentials in variable assignments

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Regular expression denial of service (ReDoS)
 * @description Inefficient regular expressions can cause denial of service
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/redos
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-1333
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, string pattern
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("re").getMember(["compile", "match", "search", "findall", "finditer", "sub", "subn", "split"]).getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("compile").getACall()
  ) and
  exists(DataFlow::Node arg |
    arg = call.getArg(0) and
    arg.asExpr().(StrConst).getText() = pattern and
    (
      // Nested quantifiers
      pattern.regexpMatch(".*\\([^)]*[*+][^)]*[*+].*") or
      // Alternation with overlapping patterns
      pattern.regexpMatch(".*\\(.*\\|.*\\)[*+].*") or
      // Excessive backtracking patterns
      pattern.regexpMatch(".*(\\.[*+]){2,}.*")
    )
  )
select call, "Regular expression may be vulnerable to denial of service (ReDoS): " + pattern
findings.hypothesis: Check for regular expressions that may be vulnerable to ReDoS attacks due to inefficient patterns
